DEBUG: Maestro setup-keyboard.yaml Full Access toggle

SYMPTOM: tapOn: 'Allow Full Access' hits the label text (left side), not the toggle switch. extendedWaitUntil: visible: 'Don't Allow' times out even when alert is clearly on screen.

CAUSE: Maestro evaluates the condition before the iOS alert animation completes. The label tap is a no-op (doesn't toggle the switch). extendedWaitUntil has a bug with iOS modal alert detection timing.

FIX:
1. Use tapOn by percentage point to hit the right side of the row: `- tapOn: { x: 73%, y: <row_y%> }`
2. Wait briefly: `- waitForAnimationToEnd`
3. Tap 'Allow' directly: `- tapOn: 'Allow'` (no conditional wait needed — if alert isn't there, it fails gracefully)

PREVENT: Never use extendedWaitUntil for iOS system alert buttons in Maestro — use direct tapOn after a brief wait.
